effect_description_eng:
＜Use Req. ([Maquinamon] in text)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] You may play 1 [Maquinamon] or [Unchained] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your [Unchained] are played, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・ 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Maquinamon] in its text in the hand without paying the cost.
